source_evidence: Many people get into the habit of saving and investing by paying themselves first. An easy way to do this is to have your bank automatically deposit money from your paycheck into a savings or investment account.
question: What does “paying yourself first” mean, and what is one way to do it?
answer: It means making saving or investing part of your financial routine. One way is to arrange for your bank to automatically deposit money from your paycheck into a savings or investment account.
